concerns.text: Principle VI is NON-NEGOTIABLE: 'every evaluation metric reported MUST explicitly compare the composition-only GNN against a structure-aware baseline.' T007 emits comparative metrics (`delta_vs_rf`, paired per-fold R² comparison) with no structure-aware run and no ratified Principle VI amendment. Executing T007 as written violates the constitution; the task list cannot proceed past this until the amendment lands or T007 is blocked behind it.

FR-002 is a MUST with an exact 4-feature list; T003 implements 5 features (element fraction added). The deviation is well justified and flagged for kickback, but the spec is unchanged (Status: Draft) — T003 knowingly violates a MUST-level requirement. The kickback must land before the task executes, or T003 must be explicitly blocked on the spec revision.

US-1 scenario 2 acceptance requires 'a confidence interval calculated as mean ± 1.96 × std'; T008/data-model emit a 'fold-disagreement band' instead. The relabeling is scientifically correct but the acceptance criterion as written cannot pass — the spec revision must precede task execution, otherwise T008's verification silently drops a spec acceptance criterion.

FR-006 mandates ΔR² = R²_composition − R²_structure-aware 'on the shared test set'; T007 replaces both the structure-aware term (with RF) and the shared test set (with 5-fold CV means). Both weakenings are documented, but the spec text is unrevised, leaving two contradictory definitions of the core metric with no task blocked on the resolution.

T002 requires the loader to raise unless 'provenance names the origin of hardness values,' but the dataset contract has no provenance/metadata field — the gate has no schema-enforced input to check, making the verification ('a missing-hardness input raises') untestable as specified. Add a provenance block to the contract or define the gate's input.

T008 'requires T007's checkpoints (fixture checkpoints for unit tests),' but T006 — the only pre-T007 run — does not state it saves checkpoints. Specify that T006's fixture run persists fold checkpoints (clearly labeled fixture-only) so T008's verification has a defined artifact when gated.
